name: Bodyweight squat

technique.setup: Stand with feet about hip to shoulder width, toes turned out slightly. Arms forward for balance or hands behind the head for the prisoner version.
cues: Keep knees tracking over the middle toes
Keep heels down the whole rep
Sit hips back and down between the heels
Stand tall and squeeze glutes at the top
mistakes: Knees caving inward
Heels lifting as you go down
Rounding the lower back at the bottom
stopIf: Sharp or joint pain in the knee
Pinching at the front of the hip

notes: Journal used wide/normal/close stances 10 each x3; keep dance turnout out of it, knees follow toes.

name: Box squat

technique.setup: Stand a short step in front of a box or bench, feet hip width. Start with a box that puts the thighs about parallel and lower it as you get stronger.
cues: Reach hips back to the box slowly
Touch the box lightly, do not sit and relax
Keep knees over the toes and heels down
Drive through the whole foot to stand
mistakes: Dropping onto the box
Rocking back to stand up
Knees caving in as you rise
stopIf: Sharp or joint pain in the knee
Pinching at the front of the hip

media.searchHint: GMB Fitness box squat pistol squat progression

notes: First step of the pistol tree. Progress by lowering the box before moving on.

name: Goblet squat

technique.setup: Hold a kettlebell (or one dumbbell) by the horns against the chest, elbows pointing down. Feet a little wider than hips, toes turned out slightly.
cues: Keep the weight tight to the chest
Push knees out over the toes
Keep heels down and chest tall
Stand by driving the floor away
mistakes: Letting the weight pull the chest forward
Knees caving in on the way up
Heels lifting at the bottom
stopIf: Sharp or joint pain in the knee
Lower back pain or pinching

notes: A dumbbell held vertically works the same. Hitting 3x15 means the next weight up.

name: Split squat

technique.setup: Take a long step so one foot is forward and the back heel is lifted. Hold a wall or doorframe for balance if needed.
cues: Drop the back knee straight down
Keep the front heel down
Keep the front knee over the middle toes
Stay tall with ribs down
mistakes: Stance too short so the front heel lifts
Front knee caving inward
Leaning far forward over the front leg
stopIf: Sharp or joint pain in either knee
Pinching at the front of the hip

notes: Add a 15 s hold at the bottom per side as a warm-up variant (marchon).

name: Bulgarian split squat

technique.setup: Stand about one long stride in front of a bench and rest the top of the back foot on it. Start bodyweight; hold dumbbells or a kettlebell once 3x12 is easy.
cues: Lower the back knee straight down
Keep the front heel down
Let the front knee travel over the toes, in line with them
Push through the front foot to stand
mistakes: Front foot too close so the heel lifts
Pushing off the back foot instead of the front leg
Front knee collapsing inward
stopIf: Sharp or joint pain in the front knee
Strain or pinching at the front of the back hip

media.searchHint: Hybrid Calisthenics Bulgarian split squat form tutorial

notes: Journal: 8 each x3 at 15 kg; marchon 5-10 with KB or dual DB.

name: TRX-assisted pistol squat

technique.setup: Face the TRX anchor holding both handles with arms long. Stand on one leg with the other leg reaching forward off the floor.
cues: Lower slowly for 3 seconds
Keep the standing heel down
Keep the knee tracking over the middle toes
Pull on the straps only as much as you need
mistakes: Pulling the whole way up with the arms
Knee caving inward at the bottom
Dropping fast into the bottom
stopIf: Sharp or joint pain in the knee
Pinching at the front of the hip

media.searchHint: FitnessFAQs assisted pistol squat progression TRX

notes: Journal: 6 per leg, slow 3 s down, x3. Use less arm help as you progress.

name: Box pistol

technique.setup: Stand on one leg with your back to a box or bench, the other leg reaching forward. Start high and lower the box as you get stronger.
cues: Lower slowly to touch the box
Keep the standing heel down
Keep the knee over the middle toes
Reach arms forward and stand without rocking
mistakes: Plopping onto the box
Rocking back to get momentum
Knee caving inward on the way up
stopIf: Sharp or joint pain in the knee
Pinching at the front of the hip

notes: Lowest box for 3x8 per side means try the full pistol.

name: Pistol squat

technique.setup: Stand on one leg, the other leg straight out in front, arms reaching forward. Practise next to a wall or doorframe until balance is steady.
cues: Lower slowly for 3 seconds
Keep the standing heel down
Keep the knee tracking over the middle toes
Reach arms forward to stay balanced
mistakes: Heel lifting at the bottom
Knee caving inward
Bouncing out of the bottom
stopIf: Sharp or joint pain in the knee
Pinching at the front of the hip

notes: Journal: 5 per leg x3; 6 per leg slow 3 s down x3. Hold a light weight forward if balance limits depth.

name: Band-assisted Nordic negative

technique.setup: Kneel on a pad with ankles hooked under a heavy bench or held by a partner. Loop a band around the chest and anchor it to a sturdy point behind and above you.
cues: Squeeze glutes and keep hips straight
Lower forward slowly for 3-5 seconds
Keep hands up, ready to catch yourself
Push back up with the hands, do not curl up
mistakes: Bending at the hips to make it easier
Falling the last part with no control
Using a band too light to control the whole range
stopIf: Sharp pain or a pull at the back of the thigh
Knee pain on the pad or behind the knee
Hamstring cramp

notes: Journal: Nordic curl 6x4. Hitting 3x6 slow negatives moves to the next lighter band. Avoid within 48 h of a hard dance class.

name: Band hamstring curl

technique.setup: Anchor a band low in a door and loop it around both ankles. Lie face down far enough away that the band is taut with legs straight.
cues: Press hips into the floor
Curl heels toward the glutes
Lower slowly for 2-3 seconds
mistakes: Lifting the hips to finish the rep
Letting the band snap the legs back
Arching the lower back
stopIf: Sharp pain or cramp at the back of the thigh
Pain behind the knee

media.searchHint: lying banded hamstring curl door anchor form

notes: Journal: lying hamstring curl 12x3. One leg at a time once both legs is easy with the heaviest band.

name: Glute bridge

technique.setup: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat and hip width, heels close enough to touch with the fingertips.
cues: Tuck the ribs down before you lift
Drive through the heels
Squeeze glutes to lift hips to a straight line
Pause one second at the top
mistakes: Arching the lower back instead of using the glutes
Pushing through the toes
Knees falling in or out
stopIf: Lower back pain or pinching
Hamstring cramp

notes: First step of the bridge tree. Journal: 12x3.

technique.setup: Lie on your back with one foot flat and the knee bent, the other knee pulled in toward the chest or the leg held straight up.
cues: Tuck the ribs down first
Drive through the planted heel
Keep hips level as you lift
Lower slowly
mistakes: Hips tilting to one side
Arching the lower back
Pushing through the toes
stopIf: Lower back pain or pinching
Hamstring cramp

name: Hip thrust

technique.setup: Sit on the floor with the shoulder blades against a bench, knees bent, feet flat. Rest a dumbbell on the hip crease over a pad or towel, holding it with both hands.
cues: Tuck the chin and ribs down
Drive through the heels
Lift hips until shins are vertical
Squeeze glutes hard at the top
mistakes: Overarching the lower back at the top
Feet too far out so hamstrings take over
Bench slipping away
stopIf: Lower back pain or pinching
Pain where the weight sits on the hips

notes: Journal: 8x3 heavy. Single-leg bodyweight version also works (marchon 5-10).

name: Kettlebell Romanian deadlift

technique.setup: Stand hip width holding a kettlebell (or two dumbbells) in front of the thighs, knees soft.
cues: Push hips back like closing a door
Keep the back long and the weight close to the legs
Stop when the hamstrings are tight
Squeeze glutes to stand tall
mistakes: Rounding the back to reach lower
Bending the knees into a squat
Leaning back at the top
stopIf: Lower back pain or pinching
Sharp pull at the back of the thigh
Numbness or tingling down the leg

notes: Journal: RDL 8x3; marchon 5-10. Hitting 3x12 means the next weight up.

name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift

technique.setup: Stand on one leg with the knee soft, arms hanging or reaching forward. Lightly touch a wall with one hand until balance is steady.
cues: Hinge at the hip as the back leg reaches back
Keep hips square to the floor
Keep the back long from head to heel
Stand by squeezing the standing glute
mistakes: Opening the hip so the back leg turns out
Rounding the back to reach lower
Locking the standing knee
stopIf: Lower back pain or pinching
Sharp pull at the back of the thigh

notes: Journal: inverted deadlift (bodyweight) 5x4. Balance limits reps at first; hold a light kettlebell to progress.

technique.setup: Stand facing a stable box and place one whole foot on top. Start at about knee height or lower.
cues: Push through the heel of the top foot
Keep the knee over the middle toes
Stand fully tall on top
Step down slowly with control
mistakes: Pushing off the bottom foot
Knee caving inward on the way up
Box so high the hip tucks under
stopIf: Sharp or joint pain in the knee
Box wobbling or slipping

name: Cossack squat

technique.setup: Stand in a wide stance, toes turned out slightly. Hold a doorframe or reach arms forward for balance.
cues: Shift into one hip and sit down over that heel
Keep the bent knee over the toes and heel down
Keep the straight leg's toes pointing up
Go only as deep as you can control
mistakes: Heel of the bent leg lifting
Knee caving inward
Rounding the back to get lower
stopIf: Sharp or joint pain in the knee
Groin pain or a pull on the inner thigh

notes: Journal: 10 each x3. Also works as an adductor warm-up.

name: Calf raise

technique.setup: Stand with the balls of the feet on a step edge, heels hanging, a hand on a wall for balance. Flat floor works too.
cues: Rise straight up onto the big toe
Hold the top for 3 seconds
Lower slowly below the step
mistakes: Bouncing at the bottom
Rolling out onto the little toes
Rushing the hold
stopIf: Sharp pain in the Achilles or calf
Calf cramp

notes: Journal: 20x3 with 3 s hold; single-leg slow 20 per leg as the progression.

technique.setup: Stand tall with space to walk forward. Hands on hips, or hold dumbbells at the sides once bodyweight is easy.
cues: Take a long step and drop the back knee straight down
Keep the front heel down
Keep the front knee over the middle toes
Push through the front foot to step through
mistakes: Short steps so the front heel lifts
Front knee caving inward
Slamming the back knee into the floor
stopIf: Sharp or joint pain in either knee
Pinching at the front of the hip
